verdict.rationale: Insomnia's design mode documents a generated preview of an OpenAPI spec in the right pane. It also generates code snippets in 12+ languages and sends requests over several protocols, which gives a thin basis for an explorable API reference with examples. Nothing shows that the preview is interactive or that its examples can be run in place, and probes found no published OpenAPI or reference for Insomnia's own API. Missing for 10: documented interactive try-it/runnable examples within the reference view, an official interactive reference for Insomnia's own API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: View a generated preview of your spec in the right pane.
Generate code snippets automatically in over 12 different programming languages.
